runtimeViewportBias.evidence: SM1A/MD0033 late-game native collision entry audit: the canonical visual topology offset is -96 px, but using it as the live collision viewport places Rick at world y=7 with an AABB above the map. A +72 px runtime-only phase moves the native collision origin onto the first valid RDX support while the rendered contact remains aligned to the Classic cold-entry contact within one pixel. The canonical visual mapping is unchanged.

tileLayerMapping.coordinateAnchor: bottom-center foot/contact point for actors; tiles are 8x8; alignment offsets are in tile units per levelMapping
tileLayerMapping.fallback: if an RDX visual asset is missing, preserve xrick sprite/tile until missing-rdx-data-research is closed
